english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for booking something in advance, especially an appointment or service.
Use this when reserving an appointment, place, or time in advance rather than merely planning it.

examples.english: I want to reserve an appointment to see the dentist next week.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jyu6 joek3 haa6 sing1 kei4 tai2 ngaa4

examples.english: I want to schedule a dentist appointment for next week.
examples.traditional: 我想預約下星期嘅牙醫。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jyu6 joek3 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 ngaa4 ji1
